correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no standard for network statistics.

brainlife.desc: Directory of CSV network tables: connectivity matrices (conmats.csv) and global and per-node network measures, tagged by subject.
brainlife.name: neuro/net-stats

original.desc: This datatype is intended for network-related statistics. In similar vein as parc-stats

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Group analysis of network measures across subjects.

**Not for:** Comparing networks built with different parcellations or thresholds.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 4 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.net-stats.json

files.desc: Directory of CSV tables (conmats.csv, global_measures.csv, local_measures.csv).

identifying_risks: Individual connectomes can re-identify a person across datasets (connectome fingerprinting)
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level derivative; step 7 moves fingerprint use to Tier 4.
sharing_cautions: Remove subject identifiers beyond participant codes before sharing
tier_conditions: Tier 4 when used or released as connectome fingerprints or to predict traits or behaviour
Tier 1 when averaged across enough participants that no individual can be singled out

intended_use: Group analysis of network measures across subjects.
not_suitable_for: Comparing networks built with different parcellations or thresholds.
